```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

proCAF vs restCAF fiber orientation variance from Mathematica, old Keyence 20x images (7 vs 8 samples).

# load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```

# per-sample variances and tests
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
# per-sample fiber orientation variances from Mathematica (rad^2)
proVariances <- c(0.657998, 0.618538, 0.51705, 0.772362, 0.407781, 0.583037, 0.589696)

restVariances <- c(0.66782, 0.465514, 0.457228, 0.42473, 0.391601, 0.466767, 0.452664,0.430305)

# T-test (unweighted, n=7 vs n=8)
t.test(proVariances, restVariances)

# Mann-Whitney test (non-parametric)
wilcox.test(proVariances, restVariances)

# Descriptive statistics
cat("proCAF mean variance:", mean(proVariances), "\n")
cat("restCAF mean variance:", mean(restVariances), "\n")
cat("Difference:", mean(restVariances) - mean(proVariances), "\n")
cat("Percent difference:", 100*(mean(restVariances) - mean(proVariances))/mean(proVariances), "%\n")

# Effect size (Cohen's d)
pooled_sd <- sqrt((var(proVariances) + var(restVariances))/2)
cohens_d <- (mean(restVariances) - mean(proVariances)) / pooled_sd
cat("Cohen's d:", cohens_d, "\n")

# Box plot
boxplot(list(proCAF=proVariances, restCAF=restVariances),
        col=c("pink", "cyan"),
        main="Within-Sample Fiber Orientation Variance",
        ylab="Variance")

# Prepare data
data <- data.frame(
  variance = c(proVariances, restVariances),
  group = c(rep("proCAF", length(proVariances)), 
            rep("restCAF", length(restVariances)))
)

# Create boxplot with significance
ggboxplot(data, x = "group", y = "variance",
          fill = "group", 
          color = "group",  # Dots follow group color
          palette = c("#C4366E", "#006666"),  # darker colors for boxes and dots
          width = 0.4,
          alpha = 0.3,  # Light fill for boxes
          add = "jitter",
          add.params = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9),  # Darker, bigger dots
          ylab = "Variance",
          xlab = "",
          title = "Within-Sample Fiber Orientation Variance") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test",
                     label.x = 1.5, 
                     label.y = 0.9) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.6, 2.4)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```
